en.title: Can a Subset of Transactions Reach the Target Balance
en.description: Given a set of integer transaction amounts, some positive and some negative, determine whether any subset (possibly empty) sums to exactly the target; output 1 if one exists, otherwise 0.
en.input: The first line contains integers n and target, followed by a line of n integers (this line may be empty when n=0). Site constraints: 0≤n≤40, |target|≤10^12, |transaction[i]|≤10^9. Each transaction can be chosen at most once.
en.output: Output a single integer: 1 if a qualifying subset exists, otherwise 0. The sum of the empty subset is 0.
en.explanation: Decide according to the definition of subset sum; to support transaction amounts with large absolute values, this site sets the missing size bound to n≤40, so meet-in-the-middle can be used.
hints: Split the transactions into two halves and enumerate the subset sums of one half; enumerate the other half one by one and look up target−sum. A Gray code lets you update the sum between adjacent enumerations in constant time.
